description: This PHP source file defines the class TimesheetDeletedEntriesParamRule, a validation rule for ensuring that an array of timesheet deletion entries contains correctly structured data with valid project and activity IDs.

classes.name: TimesheetDeletedEntriesParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks the structure and validity of timesheet deletion entries, ensuring each entry has required fields with valid numeric IDs.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the input entries array contains entries with the correct structure: exactly two fields, with 'projectId' and 'activityId' present, and their values are numeric and greater than zero.
